train.text: pub fn dma_ring_advance(head: &std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize, tail: usize, mask: usize) -> Option<usize> { let cur = head.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire); let next = (cur + 1) & mask; if next == tail { None } else { head.store(next, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release); Some(cur) } }

pub fn slice_checked_window<'a>(buf: &'a [u8], offset: usize, len: usize) -> Result<&'a [u8], &'static str> { let end = offset.checked_add(len).ok_or("overflow")?; buf.get(offset..end).ok_or("out_of_bounds") }

pub struct ZeroCopyFrame<'a> { pub header: u32, pub payload: &'a [u8] } impl<'a> ZeroCopyFrame<'a> { pub fn parse(raw: &'a [u8]) -> Option<Self> { if raw.len() < 4 { return None; } let hdr = u32::from_be_bytes([raw[0], raw[1], raw[2], raw[3]]); Some(Self { header: hdr, payload: &raw[4..] }) } }

holdout.text: pub fn dma_ring_try_pop(tail: &std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize, head: usize, mask: usize) -> Option<usize> { let cur = tail.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire); if cur == head { None } else { let next = (cur + 1) & mask; tail.store(next, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release); Some(cur) } }
pub fn slice_checked_split<'a>(buf: &'a [u8], mid: usize) -> Result<(&'a [u8], &'a [u8]), &'static str> { if mid > buf.len() { Err("out_of_bounds") } else { Ok(buf.split_at(mid)) } }

Each worker executes H=16 local AdamW inner steps on its 4-bit NF4 QLoRA shard, updates its local EF21 error-feedback state g_i^(t) = g_i^(t-1) + TopK(Delta_i^(t) - g_i^(t-1)), and broadcasts only the Top-2% FP8 compressed delta over QUIC 0-RTT.

### Protocol Spec (Adaptive Cadence Controller SI-03):
When home broadband RTT rises from 8.5 ms (LAN/Fiber) to 145 ms (RFC 5766 TURN Relay under CGNAT), increase inner step cadence H from 11 to 226 to bound WAN communication overhead below 8%.

### Protocol Spec (Rarest-First CAS Chunk Scheduler SI-08):
Split safetensors LoRA bundles into 64 KB content-addressed chunks and prioritize rarest chunks across Kademlia DHT peers with automatic SHA-256 corrupt-chunk failover.
